restaurant_name: The ARCH Dental Clinic - Sathorn (Sathorn Thani2)
text: Premise: The dentists are very good!! but the elder receptionist is really leak of pragmatism and tact. I went there 2 times for nothing; the first time the doctor was sick and I discovered it when I was there, she told me she tried to call me but she still had my old mobile number (changed 3 years before) but I chatted with the Arch studio via Line few weeks before and they surely had my number as they called me every time to remind me the previous appointments or eventual changes since I started the process to replace a crown. Of course these were other receptionists, not her! The same day I fixed the next appointment with her and to be sure i repeated 2 times Sat 7 at 2 PM … it turned out that the appointment was Tuesday 17 at 2 PM .. misunderstandings? Maybe .. very poorly managed. In addition during a treatment, the doctor stained my brand new T shirt purchased 1 week before .. I was the first to say: it can happen, no problem, but please refund me! but always the same lady, despite the evidence that it was their mistake and the receipt proofing that it was new, she had the courage to try to negotiate and refund  only me 50% .. so inappropriate and unprofessional. A pity that I have to change studio as both me and my wife did the Invisalign in the same place many years ago and it was great.. Hopefully the management will do something to improve the customer service at the front desk

restaurant_name: The ARCH Dental Clinic - Sathorn (Sathorn Thani2)
text:
- The front desk staff provided excellent service and were very polite.
- All the doctors were also very polite, greeting us with a wai (traditional Thai greeting).
- The doctors were very talkative, and when we didn't respond, they even called us arrogant!
- The clinic was very clean.
- The clinic is located on the 12th floor of Sathorn Thani Building 2. Just walk up and take the elevator; no need to exchange cards (it's a waste of time because the security guard doesn't check anything).
- The restrooms are tucked away near the clinic.
- The price is considered cheap compared to the service received.
- I highly recommend this clinic! They have doctors providing all types of dental services.
- But don't forget to make an appointment before your visit!

restaurant_name: The ARCH Dental Clinic - Sathorn (Sathorn Thani2)
text: I went for teeth whitening. The dentist was very kind and explained every step of the process well. My teeth were A3 level (the whitest they could be), but I got A1, two shades whiter. I'm very satisfied with the results. I only felt a slight tingling sensation during the second whitening session. After that, I didn't feel anything, maybe just a fleeting sensitivity sometimes. The receptionist was very polite, helpful, and gave great advice. I got a promotional price of 1766 baht, which was all I paid, no extra charges. It was great! If my teeth turn yellow again next year, I'll definitely go back.

restaurant_name: The ARCH Dental Clinic - Sathorn (Sathorn Thani2)

text: I highly recommend this place. Everything is great, from the counter staff and assistants to the dentist.
